stage0022_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「...That's the situation in the city of $$ア・コバ$$.」

stage0022_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「The $$ＰＳ$$ you've been adjusting...
　how is $$ラダァ・ニーバ$$ progressing?」

stage0022_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Yes... the tests proceed smoothly.
　A few more real battles and it's combat ready.」

stage0022_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Some of the 《$$ネクスタント$$》's technology went
　into him. Failure will not be tolerated.」

stage0022_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Once testing ends and $$ＰＳ$$ mass production
　succeeds, it will strengthen 《$$マーティアル$$》.」

stage0022_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「That would bring me great joy.」

stage0022_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I too am heading to $$ア・コバ$$.
　I want to see the 'Untouchable' myself.」

stage0022_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Lady $$テイタニア$$ is coming here herself!?」

stage0022_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「No, not at all!
　I'm honored to meet Lady $$テイタニア$$,
　holder of the title 'Shield of Order'!」

stage0022_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「If you can defeat him yourselves, so be it.
　I leave it to you until I arrive.」

stage0022_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「So that's 《$$マーティアル$$》's 《$$ネクスタント$$》...」

stage0022_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「That's Lady $$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.
　She holds the 13th rank, 'Shield of Order'.」

stage0022_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Tough break for you.
　Just because your higher-ups were $$マーティアル$$
　believers, you couldn't join the Federation.」

stage0022_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「...Don't remind me.
　But once we complete you as a $$ＰＳ$$,
　all our hardship will be repaid.」

stage0022_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「So basically, I just need to kill Chirico
　Cuvie before that woman arrives, right?」

stage0022_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Then don't you worry.
　I'll send him to hell with my own hands.」

stage0022_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「D, do your best.
　I'm going to get some rest.」

stage0022_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Kukuku... he's my prey.
　I won't hand him to $$マーティアル$$...」

stage0022_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「About that $$キリコ$$,
　he's been acting strange since yesterday.」

stage0022_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「It seems he intends to contact the Gilgamesh
　people who came to $$ア・コバ$$.」

stage0022_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$'s woman is a 《$$ＰＳ$$》 Gilgamesh developed.
　He likely needs to meet a Gilgamesh researcher
　for her sake.」

stage0022_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Put another way, that $$ＰＳ$$ woman is
　$$キリコ$$'s weakness.」

stage0022_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Sounds like you have a plan?
　Let's hear it.」

stage0022_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アルト$$
「...So $$キリコ$$ went with $$バニラ$$ and the others
　to meet that Gilgamesh person?」

stage0022_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$マオ$$
「More like he plans to kidnap
　the person, not just meet them.」

stage0022_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Why would he do something like that...!?」

stage0022_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ルカ$$
「$$フィアナ$$, being a 《$$ＰＳ$$》, is a valuable
　asset to Gilgamesh, after all.」

stage0022_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ルカ$$
「They're likely searching for $$フィアナ$$ in $$ア・コバ$$
　to take her back.」

stage0022_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Can't take her to a place like that, so
　he's making them come to him instead.」

stage0022_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But to make an enemy of the Federation
　just for that...」

stage0022_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$マオ$$
「Precisely because he knows that,
　$$キリコ$$ must have acted alone.」

stage0022_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I want to root for $$キリコ$$, sure,
　but the situation is what it is.
　Guess we just watch him for now.」

stage0022_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アルト$$
「You've got a face that says you're not convinced.」

stage0022_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Seems I overestimated that man $$キリコ$$.」

stage0022_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$宗介$$
「I thought him a calm soldier, but to be
　driven by emotion into a losing spot...」

stage0022_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「This time I agree with $$宗介$$ too.
　I get the reasons, but there's a smarter way.」

stage0022_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Colonel $$ジェフリー$$, sir, do you need something!?」

stage0022_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No need to be so formal.
　...I started out as a pilot myself.
　Stopping by the hangar is a nice break for me.」

stage0022_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are you thinking about what I said earlier...」

stage0022_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$キリコ$$'s approach surely isn't clever.
　But that doesn't make it wrong, either.」

stage0022_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「To protect Miss $$フィアナ$$...
　to spare us any trouble...
　because time is of the essence...」

stage0022_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Reckless as it looks from the outside,
　it has its own logic to him.」

stage0022_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Explain the rest to him yourself.」

stage0022_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アルト$$
「It's that acting to protect someone
　precious has no right or wrong.」

stage0022_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's not what I mean.
　Like, someone such as $$かなめ$$ is to you.」

stage0022_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$宗介$$
「Where does Chidori come into it?」

stage0022_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アルト$$
「Just a hunch on my part.」

stage0022_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$n
「I see...
　So $$キリコ$$ and I are the same...」

stage0022_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$宗介$$
「That you got it from that explanation
　baffles me more than Chirico does.」

stage0022_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Someday you'll understand $$キリコ$$ too.」

stage0022_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アルト$$
（No... maybe that time already came,
　and he just hasn't noticed it himself...）

stage0022_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Look who's talking, Volunteer Club president.
　Love lessons for the broody duo?」

stage0022_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Compared to these two,
　I'm still the better off one.」

stage0022_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh... declaring yourself a love pro?
　I'll take that as a challenge to me.」

stage0022_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「No, no... that's a challenge to me.」

stage0022_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$マオ$$
「Give it up, Snooper.
　At least in looks, $$アルト$$'s got you beat.」

stage0022_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch... even I surrender on that one.
　With that face, he's got plenty of practice.」

stage0022_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Basically, $$アルト$$'s an ace.
　A night time one.」

stage0022_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Simply put, he racks up girls left and right.
　His specialty move is the multi lock on.」

stage0022_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミシェル$$!
　Don't feed $$宗介$$ that nonsense!」

stage0022_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$n
「I see...
　So that's the kind of guy you really are.」

stage0022_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アルト$$
「What do you mean by 'really are'!?」

stage0022_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$マオ$$
「Being good looking is a real sin.
　That alone marks you as a foe to every guy around.」

stage0022_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
（At times like this, he's just a normal young man...）

stage0022_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.
　Thanks to you, $n seems to have
　come to understand $$キリコ$$ too.」

stage0022_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Miss $$スズネ$$,
　once this ends, might I have a moment of your time?」

stage0022_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「There's something I'd like
　to discuss about $F.」

stage0022_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$トムス$$
「W, what in the world is this!?」

stage0022_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Sorry about this, old man.
　Anyway, welcome to our hideout.」

stage0022_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$トムス$$
「W, what do you plan to do, kidnapping me!?」

stage0022_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Calm down a bit.
　We know you and the others
　were looking for $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0022_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$トムス$$
「$$フィアナ$$...!?
　The first 《$$ＰＳ$$》, taken by the $$秘密結社$$...!」

stage0022_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$キリコ$$
「$$カルマン・トムス$$...
　One of the technical officers in the Gilgamesh
　army who took part in the $$ＰＳ$$ project?」

stage0022_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Don't be so scared.
　We're going to let you meet
　the $$フィアナ$$ you were looking for.」

stage0022_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$トムス$$
「...This weakened state... just as I thought...」

stage0022_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$トムス$$
「Fearing this would happen,
　we've been pursuing the $$ＰＳ$$.」

stage0022_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$トムス$$
「Listen.
　A $$ＰＳ$$ is a human with enhanced biological functions.
　It always needs fine adjustment and health care.」

stage0022_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$トムス$$
「Even so, there are limits.
　As the price of that enhancement, a $$ＰＳ$$...」

stage0022_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
Niva
「Name's $$ラダァ・ニーバ$$.
　A $$ＰＳ$$, same as that woman there.」

stage0022_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$トムス$$
「You... a Balarant $$ＰＳ$$!?
　But that was supposed to remain just a plan!」

stage0022_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$トムス$$
「D, don't tell me...!
　They incorporated $$マーティアル$$'s technology...」

stage0022_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Oops... guess I put too much into it.」

stage0022_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$バニラ$$
「T-t-this guy...!
　Bare hands, on a person!」

stage0022_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$,
　fight me in an AT.」

stage0022_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Those eyes...
　So it's true, you're $$レッドショルダー$$.」

stage0022_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「If you refuse to fight, I have my own plan.」

stage0022_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Get out of the way, Quentian!」

stage0022_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ココナ$$
「You monster!
　Let go of $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0022_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Damn you!
　$$フィアナ$$ was your target from the start!?」

stage0022_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$!
　If you want the woman back, be at
　the edge of $$ア・コバ$$ at 8am tomorrow!」

stage0022_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「We'll fight two on two!
　Bring along someone you trust!」

stage0022_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Stop it, $$キリコ$$!
　If you shoot here, you'll hit $$フィアナ$$ too!」

stage0022_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ココナ$$
「What is with that guy!?
　Did he kidnap $$フィアナ$$ just to get
　$$キリコ$$ riled up!?」

stage0022_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「What's the meaning of this, $$ボーソン$$!?
　When did I ask for reinforcements!?」

stage0022_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Calm down, $$ニーバ$$.
　I merely acted to secure
　a more certain victory.」

stage0022_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「You must really want credit before
　that $$マーティアル$$ woman arrives.」

stage0022_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「But don't forget!
　That $$レッドショルダー$$ is my prey!」

stage0022_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Understood.
　I'll permit a rematch with him.」

stage0022_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「First, I want today's battle data.
　Lie down on the bed.」

stage0022_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Tch...
　Don't forget what you just said.」

stage0022_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Even you can't tear apart
　steel restraints.」

stage0022_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Don't take it personally, $$ニーバ$$.
　Your test is over.」

stage0022_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「If I fumble this, losing you
　is the one thing I must avoid.」

stage0022_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Let go!
　Let me fight him!」

stage0022_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Silence!
　You'll be punished for this!」

stage0022_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「You've done as you pleased
　long enough! That hostage you brought
　saddled us with needless trouble!」

stage0022_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Now we'll release the hostage
　to distract them, and retreat!」

stage0022_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I won't... let you do that!」

stage0022_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Give it up, $$ニーバ$$.
　You're nothing but a pet dog.」

stage0022_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Don't forget!
　Orders are absolute!」

stage0022_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I don't pilot an AT for the army
　or for money. It's about killing...!」

stage0022_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Sure, the army's fine.
　They'll praise a plain murderer as
　a fighting force. But that's all!」

stage0022_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「It stops being enough fast...!
　And I have to fight him!」

stage0022_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Then I'll simply control your mind!」

stage0022_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Swear your obedience, $$ニーバ$$!
　You're a soldier who obeys orders!」

stage0022_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Ngh...! No!
　He's $$レッドショルダー$$!
　I can't let him live...!」

stage0022_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Volunteering myself for $$ＰＳ$$ conversion,
　living on with half my body turned to machine,
　it's all just to kill him, $$レッドショルダー$$!」

stage0022_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「A soldier need only obey orders!」

stage0022_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「The army's orders are absolute!」

stage0022_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ボーソン$$
「Impossible!
　He tore the restraints apart!」

stage0022_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Now no one's left to get in my way...」

stage0022_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Wait for me, $$レッドショルダー$$...!
　I'll set the perfect stage
　to settle things between us!」

stage0022_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Let him be alone for now.」

stage0022_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So, what's up with that organization?」

stage0022_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$マオ$$
「No report's come in from Major $$カリーニン$$.
　Meaning they're still hiding somewhere.」

stage0022_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$バニラ$$
「This is maddening!
　Can't even the mighty $$ミスリル$$ and
　$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ do anything about it!?」

stage0022_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Calm down, $$バニラ$$.
　All that's left for them is
　to fight us.」

stage0022_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Now it's about how we counter that,
　while also rescuing $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0022_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Still, they're cornered now...
　wonder what move they'll make...」

stage0022_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「$$ゴウト$$! You there, $$ゴウト$$!?」

stage0022_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「What is it, $$チェロキー$$?
　I told you I'm done dealing with
　a miser like you.」

stage0022_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「This isn't the time for that!
　I've been asked to arrange a wild
　battle against your own crew!」

stage0022_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「Brace yourselves, everyone!
　They're bringing out a $$地上戦艦$$!」

stage0022_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$クルツ$$
「A $$地上戦艦$$, you mean the
　kind the $$アストラギウス$$ lot used!?」

stage0022_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「That's right!
　The biggest Big Battle in history,
　you against it!」

stage0022_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, well.
　Today I really savored Master $$キリコ$$,
　the 'Untouchable', the '$$異能生存体$$'.」

stage0022_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Taking down that latest AT, the
　$$エクルビス$$, your skill exceeds the rumors.」

stage0022_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And that man $$ニーバ$$'s cry of
　resentment made for fine Z-Chips.」

stage0022_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The total, a whopping 200Z!
　I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0022_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now I'm even more excited for the next Big Battle!
　I hope it makes for wonderful Z-Chips!」

stage0022_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Master $$キリコ$$.
　Customizing your unit for the decisive battle?」

stage0022_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you like, would you care to
　purchase the $$ミッションディスク$$ I've prepared?」

stage0022_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a special edition, analyzing
　Master $$キリコ$$'s piloting traits so far
　and today's $$ＰＳ$$ battle data.」

stage0022_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now hold on a moment!
　Fighting that monster with a
　normal $$ミッションディスク$$ is reckless!」

stage0022_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Preparations are already made.
　All that's left is modifying the AT.」

stage0022_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... is that so?
